title: Nice Nutty Egyptian Citrus Parfait
description: A refreshing Egyptian dessert featuring citrus flavors and crunchy nuts, low in carbs and perfect for warm evenings.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the orange blossom water, lemon juice, and sugar-free sweetener until well combined.
In a separate large bowl, whip the heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks.
Fold the whipped cream into the almond milk until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the orange blossom water mixture into the cream mixture.
Spoon a layer of the cream mixture into the bottom of a glass or parfait dish.
Add a layer of vanilla ice cream on top of the cream layer.
Sprinkle a layer of chopped almonds and pistachios over the ice cream.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of cream on top.
Garnish with orange segments and shredded coconut.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
